title: GOG Galaxy Library Failure Rate
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gog:library
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(library_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by game_title
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often GOG Galaxy library records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each game.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize library_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per game.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It automatically which parts of your GOG Galaxy library data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
